en.title: Nine killed as Learjet 60 crashes in Greenacres, Florida, after pilots report icing and turbulence
en.summary: A Learjet 60 flying from Austin, Texas, to North Eleuthera in the Bahamas crashed in a residential area of Palm Beach County, Florida, on November 1, killing all nine people aboard; investigators have not yet established a cause.
body: A Learjet 60 carrying nine people crashed in Greenacres, in Palm Beach County, Florida, on November 1, after a dramatic nose-down descent, erupting in a fireball on impact near Military Trail and 10th Avenue North, about six miles from Mar-a-Lago. The aircraft, registered N722BD, had departed Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) in Texas for North Eleuthera Airport (ELH) in the Bahamas. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that everyone aboard died, and Florida Governor Ron DeSantis said there were no immediate reports of anyone on the ground being killed or injured.

The pilots had reported icing and turbulence before the sudden descent, according to the reports, and the crash occurred at approximately 12:50 p.m. local time. The impact left a crater in the roadway, damaged power lines and water mains, and closed Military Trail between Cresthaven Boulevard and 10th Avenue North while emergency crews responded. About 600 nearby residents were evacuated to shelters, and a local school was closed on Monday.

The National Transportation Safety Board is leading the investigation, with assistance from the Federal Aviation Administration, and investigators will examine the aircraft's maintenance history, engine performance, flight-control systems, weather conditions and recorded flight data. The identities of those aboard had not immediately been released, and no cause has yet been established.

zh.title: 佛羅里達Learjet60墜毀9人罹難機組曾通報結冰與亂流
zh.summary: 一架由美國德州奧斯汀飛往巴哈馬北伊柳塞拉的Learjet60，11月1日在佛羅里達州棕櫚灘郡格林埃克斯住宅區墜毀，機上9人全數罹難，事故原因尚未查明。
body: 這架Learjet60機上共有9人，11月1日在佛羅里達州棕櫚灘郡格林埃克斯以機頭朝下的姿態急墜，撞擊後起火，地點在軍事步道與北10大道附近，距離海湖莊園約6英里。飛機登記編號為N722BD，原定由德州奧斯汀柏格斯壯國際機場飛往巴哈馬北伊柳塞拉機場。美國運輸部長達菲證實機上人員全數罹難，佛羅里達州州長德桑蒂斯表示，初步未接獲地面人員死亡或受傷的通報。
報導指出，機組在急墜前曾通報結冰與亂流，墜毀時間約為當地時間12時50分。撞擊在路面留下大坑，損壞電力線路與自來水管，軍事步道在克雷斯特黑文大道至北10大道之間封閉，緊急人員到場處理，約600名附近居民被疏散至收容處所，當地一所學校也在星期一停課。
美國國家運輸安全委員會主導調查，美國聯邦航空總署協助，調查人員將檢視飛機維修紀錄、發動機性能、飛控系統、天候狀況與飛航紀錄資料。機上人員身分尚未立即公布，事故原因尚未確定。

facts.claim: A Learjet 60 carrying nine people crashed in Greenacres, Palm Beach County, Florida, near Military Trail and 10th Avenue North, about six miles from Mar-a-Lago.
The aircraft, registered N722BD, was flying from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport to North Eleuthera Airport in the Bahamas.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that all nine people aboard were killed, and the crash occurred at approximately 12:50 p.m. local time.
The pilots reported icing and moderate turbulence before the sudden descent.
About 600 nearby residents were evacuated to shelters, and Military Trail was closed between Cresthaven Boulevard and 10th Avenue North.
The NTSB is leading the investigation, with FAA assistance, and no cause has yet been established.
